headlines.title: DoorDash And 2 Other Great Growth Stocks To Own
headlines.summary: Democrats taking control of Congress has sharpened political focus on inflation, wages, and the cost of living. That puts faster growing, financially solid businesses in the spotlight as investors look for companies that can potentially grow earnings even as policy debates drag on. This article walks through three stocks that screen well for robust profit growth potential and balance sheet health, giving you a focused shortlist to research further.

headlines.title: Trump’s FTC Turns to DoorDash’s Pricing and Dasher Pay After the Instacart Deal
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysOn Oct. 28, the FTC ordered DoorDash, Instacart, Walmart and six other companies to explain whether they use personal data to set prices and gig-worker pay, a day before DoorDash agreed to buy Instacart for about $17 billion.

headlines.title: DoorDash Delivers Strong Q3 FCF, and DASH Rises After Its InstaCart Takeover Bid
headlines.summary: DoorDash confirmed it will offer $65 in cash (75%) and stock to buy Instacart, and also delivered strong Q3 FCF. As a result, DASH stock is up as of Oct. 26 ahead of the Oct. 27 pre-market announcement.

description: DoorDash, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates a commerce platform that connects merchants, consumers, and dashers in the United States and internationally. The company operates DoorDash Marketplace, Wolt Marketplace, and Deliveroo Marketplace, which provide various services, such as customer acquisition, demand generation, order fulfillment, merchandising, payment processing, and customer support. It also offers consumer membership programs, DashPass, Wolt+, and Deliveroo Plus; advertising as a value-added service through its marketplaces; and white-label delivery fulfillment services, as well as services that help merchants establish online ordering, build branded mobile apps, manage reservations and in-store dining, manage consumer relationships, enable tableside order and pay, and improve customer support. The company was formerly known as Palo Alto Delivery Inc. and changed its name to DoorDash, Inc. in 2015. DoorDash, Inc. was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
